question: Does VARE preserve distinct rollout-group boundaries through RVLGRPOHooks into the pinned RVL trainer's per-prompt GRPO advantage normalization when multiple VARE groups share the same task/prompt ID?
hypothesis: VARE preserves groups in replay but the RVL adapter drops vare_rollout_group before training. Since the pinned trainer normalizes by Generation.prompt_id, repeated curriculum draws of the same task can merge distinct GRPO groups and change the supplied policy-update advantages.
estimand: Maximum absolute difference between the advantage vector produced by RVLGRPOHooks.train_candidate and the vector obtained by independently normalizing rewards within each declared VARE rollout group, preserving sample order.
success_gate: primary metric <= 1e-12 and trainer receives exactly one finite advantage per input sample
baseline_gate: The pinned-RVL default path must reproduce prompt-ID merging for the fixture; otherwise reject or revise the hypothesized integration path before making a code change.
positive_controls: When each VARE group has a distinct prompt_id, adapter behavior matches the pinned trainer's default per-prompt normalization.
Within-group reward contrasts are preserved when the same prompt appears in multiple VARE groups.
resource_limit: Deterministic CPU unit fixture using fake model/backend/trainer state only; no model download, model forward/backward, GPU, paid API, network service, or external spending.
interpretation_limit: An adapter correctness result only. It does not measure optimizer effectiveness, policy improvement, task success, verifier quality, or external reproduction.
